name: Merchant Onboarding
description: AI-powered merchant onboarding platform with document processing, OFAC sanctions screening, fraud detection, and human-in-the-loop approvals. Reduces onboarding time from 5-7 days to 1-2 days via multi-agent orchestration on Amazon Bedrock.

frameworks.name: Strands Agents SDK
frameworks.description: Strands-based multi-agent workflow: DocumentProcessor, ComplianceChecker, AccountProvisioner

deployment_patterns.name: AWS CDK
deployment_patterns.description: Multi-stack CDK deployment (Onboarding API + Bedrock Agent + React Frontend)

parameters.name: project_name
parameters.description: Project name prefix for all AWS resources

example_use_cases: OFAC sanctions screening with AI risk assessment
Self-service merchant portal with real-time status tracking
author: AVA Team

outputs.api_endpoint: API Gateway endpoint for the onboarding REST API
outputs.frontend_url: CloudFront URL for the merchant onboarding dashboard
outputs.user_pool_id: Cognito User Pool ID for admin authentication
